reels.title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: High audience velocity multiplier (1.45x) and strong potential for 3b1b-style geometric animation showing how simulated 'motion blueprints' guide a robot's real-world movement.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How do we teach robots to move like humans without breaking everything they touch in the real world?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Using a 'ghostly shadow' or motion-capture rig that the robot tries to perfectly overlap as it moves in the physical room.
